source.material: Three adult friends sit at a café table. One tells a light story about accidentally taking an identical umbrella after a rainy commute, while another responds with amused questions. The third friend stays with the gathering and nobody enters, leaves, or changes seats.

source_abstraction.premise: Three companions share a relaxed break at a coffee house while one recounts an amusing minor mix-up from their daily routine.
source_abstraction.interaction_arc: One person begins narrating a lighthearted personal blunder, prompting curious reactions and playful teasing from a companion while the group remains seated together sharing drinks.

shots.beat: A sets down a ceramic mug and begins recounting a humorous morning mishap with animated hand gestures. B leans forward over the table to listen while adjusting round glasses, and C takes a sip from a coffee cup with an amused grin.
A chuckles while miming the clumsy sequence of events with both hands. B laughs quietly and shakes his head at A's description.
B playfully teases A about the mistake while resting one elbow on the tabletop. A covers both cheeks with open palms in lighthearted embarrassment before reaching back for the ceramic mug.

shots.content: In a quiet café seating area with a rectangular wooden table positioned parallel to a window, a tall floor plant stands directly behind the table's plant-side short end, the café counter lies beyond the opposite short end, and an open aisle runs along the side opposite the window. Sitting at the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant, a person in a mustard yellow knit sweater with short curly auburn hair sets down a ceramic mug and begins recounting a humorous morning mishap with animated hand gestures. At the window-side seat nearest the café counter, a person wearing an olive green utility shirt and round wire-rimmed glasses leans forward over the table to listen while adjusting the glasses. Meanwhile, at the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, a person in a navy blue denim jacket with long dark hair tied in a high ponytail takes a sip from a coffee cup with an amused grin.

The person in the mustard yellow knit sweater with short curly auburn hair chuckles while miming the clumsy sequence of events with both hands. The person in the olive green utility shirt with round wire-rimmed glasses laughs quietly and shakes their head at the lively description.

Resting one elbow on the tabletop, the person in the olive green utility shirt with round wire-rimmed glasses playfully teases about the mistake. The person in the mustard yellow knit sweater with short curly auburn hair covers both cheeks with open palms in lighthearted embarrassment before reaching back for the ceramic mug.
